title: Wings live: Deutschlandhalle, Berlin | 1976
content:
Wings performed at the Deutschlandhalle in West Berlin, Germany, on 23 March 1976.

It was the 25th night of the 65-date Wings Over The World Tour, which ran from September 1975 to October 1976.

Wings were Paul McCartney on vocals, guitar, bass guitar, and keyboards; Linda McCartney on vocals and keyboards; Denny Laine on vocals, guitar, and bass guitar; Jimmy McCulloch on guitar and vocals; and Joe English on drums, plus a horns and brass section consisting of Howie Casey, Tony Dorsey, Steve Howard, and Thaddeus Richard.

While in Berlin the band was photographed by the Berlin Wall holding a banner on which ‘SILLY LOVE SONGS’ was written.

Wings had previously performed at the Deutschlandhalle during the Wings Over Europe Tour on 24 August 1972.
